name: Single-Leg Reach

instructions.description: Stand on one leg with the other leg hovering lightly behind you.
Hinge slightly at the hips and reach both hands forward or toward the floor while the free leg moves back.
Keep the standing knee softly bent and the pelvis square.
Return to upright control and repeat before changing sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Perform slow repetitions with stable balance.

variations.variationDescription: Adds a hip hinge and reach to the static single-leg stance.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Let the free foot touch the floor for balance assistance.

commentsNotes: Move through a small range if balance is limited.
Do not round the spine to reach farther.
